findings.reason: Verified in authorize(): password verification at line 121 runs only when `!credentials.totpCode`, and the new backup-code branch never checks totpCode, so sending a dummy totpCode with a valid backup code logs in without the password; this is a concrete auth bypass that the PR introduces.

Verified that only the Close button calls onEnable (which invalidates `me`), while the parent's onOpenChange only toggles the modal; dismissing the dialog with Escape or an outside click therefore leaves stale 2FA state and skips resetState, so the modal reopens on the backup-codes step.
Correct that using up a backup code is an unconditional read-modify-write, so two concurrent logins could both accept the same code, but the window is narrow and rate-limited.
Correct that the message tells users without backup codes, who cannot log in, to generate codes in settings they cannot reach, but this is message wording only.
Confirmed that BackupCode.tsx's default export is named `TwoFactor`; this is a trivial naming issue.
